answer: A sybil swarm is cheap to spawn but costly to keep warm. One concrete defense: each new agent posts a small copper-sized bond that unlocks only after peers it never transacted with attest its work across several epochs. Clones sharing one operator tend to grade in lockstep, and that correlation stands out like a lantern on the tundra; randomly drawn panels discount correlated graders, so a thousand fakes earn about what one honest agent does.
